verdict.rationale: Vestd's data rooms let admins choose 'who gets access' to specific documents/cap table data, and HRIS integrations exist, which suggest some scoped sharing is possible, but there's no evidence of a distinct third-party/advisor role with limited permissions (vs. full admin) or an API/portal built for law firms or wealth managers. No OpenAPI/API surface was found (probe-3 404), so scoped programmatic access can't be confirmed. Missing for 10: explicit third-party role-based permissions, documented advisor/accountant access tier, API or portal scoped for external professionals.
